name: Podman Remote Client
description: Installs the Podman CLI and configures it to talk to the host's Podman socket (Docker-outside-of-Docker). Binds the host podman.sock into the container and sets CONTAINER_HOST so podman commands run containers on the host. The socket path is a bind mount, so a host that uses a non-default location must override this feature's mount in devcontainer.json.

hostSocketPath.description: Conventional path to the host Podman socket. Kept as the documented default; the actual bind mount is static and the source path follows this value.
